title: adr-authoring-skill Input
description: Input contract for creating an Architecture Decision Record

decision_context.description: Description of the problem or deviation that requires an ADR. Must explain the forcing function, not just the chosen solution.

prd_requirement_id.description: The PRD requirement ID that justifies this architectural decision (e.g., NFR-03, FR-07).

deviation_category.description: Category of deviation from the Golden Model. Use 'irreversible_decision' for non-deviation decisions that are costly to reverse.

proposed_title.description: Suggested ADR title. Will be converted to kebab-case for filename. Format: 'Use X instead of Y for Z'.

alternatives.description: At least 2 alternatives considered, including the Golden Path default.

existing_adrs.description: List of already-assigned ADR IDs to prevent number collision.

triggering_gate.description: Gate number that is blocked pending this ADR's approval.
